column1: # Part-of-speech register for the Inglisce dictionary.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored. Alignment is free —
# tabs or spaces, before or after the dash, make no difference.
# A tag may contain spaces ("m n", "def v") but never a hyphen; that is what
# makes the dash an unambiguous boundary. The old whitespace-separated form
# could not tell "def v defective verb" from "defin definite article"
# This file decides which tags are LEGAL. etym-lint warns on any (pos) tag
# in the dictionary that is missing here.
